purpose: Private research handoff; source and narrative documentation, not a dataset release.

codex.selection: Current working-tree source/docs, including untracked research work; tracked source clean at export.

claude.selection: Committed tree only; uncommitted work and temporary worktrees excluded.

modification_policy: Research code unchanged; crossline Markdown navigation rewritten only in publication copies.
manifest_scope: Hashes cover imported research files only. Root handoff files and tooling are covered by the new Git commit.
